name: Argentina Culture
blurb: Football, flag and everyday ritual — Argentina's most recognisable symbols, cast into cases a buyer's customers wear because they mean something, not just because of the colour.
intro: Every piece in this collection starts from one Argentine reference — a number, an emblem, a shared cup of mate — and renders it in dimensional resin rather than a flat print. Built for football-culture retail, fan merchandise and Latin American gift shops that want real specificity.

name: Mexico Culture
blurb: Aztec geometry, Maya glyphs, Catrina calaveras and more — Mexico's design heritage, laser-engraved across two shell materials: a biodegradable wheat-straw case and a fleece-lined liquid silicone case.
intro: This collection spans two product lines carrying eighteen Mexican pattern stories. Four motifs live on a matte, biodegradable wheat-straw shell as a same-colour 3D relief; fourteen more — spanning Día de los Muertos icons, craft traditions, wrestling culture and Mesoamerican mythology — live on a soft-touch, fleece-lined liquid silicone shell as a same-colour laser-engraved, flush-smooth finish. Neither is a print: both hold their pattern as texture, not ink. Built for retailers and gift buyers serving Mexico and the wider Latin American market who want cultural depth across more than one material story.

name: Art Deco Luxury
blurb: Machine-age geometry in slate blue and gold, hand-set with rhinestones — the studio's flagship luxury design.
intro: One design, built on the defining visual language of 1920s Art Deco: layered fan-shaped arcs, symmetry and controlled ornament, cast in a clear protective shell with an electroplated camera frame.

name: Balletcore & Vintage
blurb: Bows, pearls and lace in a soft pastel palette — expressive, gift-worthy design for an aesthetic-driven customer.
intro: A recognisable balletcore / vintage-coquette look built from deliberate details — a printed-in-place bow, pearl relief, a fine lace motif — rather than one big pattern.

name: Floral Story
blurb: Real pressed petals sealed in resin — romantic, nature-driven design with no flag or fandom attached.
intro: Designs carried entirely by colour and material rather than a place: warm and cool blossoms, silver star flecks, and genuine dried petals sealed permanently into the resin layer.
